# RB-08 Delivery failure or consumer outage

Scope: out of scope (external destination; owner scope correction, 11 Nov 2026). Kept for the record, not complete. Back to the [index](README.md).

| Field                         | Content                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| ----------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Trigger                       | M-DL-1, M-DL-3, M-DL-4, M-DL-5, M-DL-8                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| Operator role                 | WS5                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| First checks                  | Confirm retries are bounded and check the destination's own status.                                                                                                                                                                |
| Steps                         | The website serves its last good state or an explicit unavailable answer (B06-05); resume and verify. For NabaPresence an uncertain write is never re-sent: its recovery job reads back, and a retry is a person's new change set. |
| Narrowest switch              | Pause publication per destination; withdrawals keep running                                                                                                                                                                        |
| Switches in the catalogue     | none                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| Data implications             | Desired revisions are kept; nothing is re-created.                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Pending delivery              | Pending revisions deliver in order once the destination returns.                                                                                                                                                                   |
| Readback that proves recovery | The destination reaches acknowledged and verified.                                                                                                                                                                                 |

## Checks without a database

- None. The claims need a database; see the drill.

## Drill

- Description: Take a fixture consumer down; observe lag and errors; bring it back; reach acknowledged and verified.
- Readiness: waiting (waiting for B05, B06)
- Status: not_exercised
- Environment: an owned isolated stack only, never production or a shared database.
- Evidence: `evidence/b10-02/RB-08/`
